title: The guard resolves a `git -C <path>` target the way it resolves a cd, so an agent's commit into the primary checkout is refused
why: Coordinator 13:27 CST Nov 8: an agent's `git -C <primary checkout> commit/add` is allowed by the guard, while `cd <primary> && git commit` is refused (other_checkout_hit). It is the same mistake class as the cd form.
note: Sighting (coordinator 19:47 CST Nov 9, from runner 8): after a resume, the runner's primary checkout moves to the main checkout. The other-checkout guard then refuses `git -C <batch worktree> checkout` in the runner's own worktree, but lets `env -C <batch worktree> git checkout` through. Either the refusal is a false alarm on a session's own worktree after a resume, or `env -C` is a hole; one of the two needs a fix.
